description: Returns what coverage a defense plays: its man vs zone rate, coverage shell mix, blitz and pressure rate, and what it allowed against man and zone, from the 2025 season (nflverse has no 2026 coverage file yet), plus its 2026 season-to-date blitz rate, average pass rushers and box count (FTN charting via nflverse). Use it for "does this defense play man or zone?" and "how often does it blitz?". Basic plan and above.

team.description: Defense team code. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

name: get_defense_coverage

coverage.description: 2025 season: man_pct and zone_pct (0-100), shell mix, blitz_pct, pressure_pct, avg_box and what the defense allowed vs man and vs zone (targets, yards, EPA).

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

pressure.description: 2026 season to date: blitz_pct, avg_pass_rushers, avg_box, play_action_faced_pct.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

source.description: Attribution: nflverse, CC-BY-4.0; blitz charting is FTN data via nflverse.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

title: Defense coverage profile
